attributes.action: Stop misleading the public with exaggerated defence spending claims
attributes.additional_details:
Successive governments have used misleading "Cold War" claims to exaggerate defence spending increases. This political spin masks the reality of stretched public services and fails to reflect true historical spending.
​We call on the Government to stop these exaggerated comparisons and publish transparent, honest breakdowns distinguishing actual front-line combat capability funding from re-badged or administrative budgets.
attributes.background: ​Governments use misleading "Cold War" claims to exaggerate defence spending while public services struggle. We want the Government to stop these exaggerated comparisons and publish transparent, honest breakdowns of actual front-line defence funding.

rejection.details: We are not clear what action you would like to see. You can start a new petition setting out clearly what you would like the UK Government or Parliament to do.
